_comment: Scoped to what this repo can pass TODAY (Tests enabled 2026-09-03). A gate that is red on day one for reasons unrelated to the change being gated gets bypassed, and then it protects nothing. Re-enable each check below as its debt is paid; see docs/PRIORITY-ROADMAP.md Tier 2.

_disabledChecks._why: next lint reports many pre-existing errors (mostly @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any). Enable once they are cleared or downgraded in .eslintrc.json.
_disabledChecks.label: Lint

_disabledChecks._why: Pre-existing errors remain -- measure with `npx tsc --noEmit`, do not trust a count written here (this line said 469 long after it stopped being true). The types/database.ts regeneration that caused most of them landed in 9f9fb37 and 4e024be; what is left is local interface shapes that drifted, plus ~50 in tailwind.config.ts. Clear them, then enable. Note next.config.ts sets ignoreBuildErrors, so Build passing says nothing about types.
_disabledChecks.label: Type check

_disabledChecks._why: No E2E framework and no test:e2e script.
_disabledChecks.label: E2E
